theme_direction: Hybrid (Light Editorial Hero + Dark Tech Showcase)

headings.usage_rules: Do NOT use Inter for headings. Headings must have tight letter spacing (`tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`). Never center-align by default; prefer strong left-alignment to create an editorial, authoritative feel.

body.usage_rules: Clean, geometric but humanist sans for high legibility. Use relaxed line-height (`leading-relaxed`) for body paragraphs.

brand_accent.description: Electric Emerald. Used sparingly as a signal color for CTAs, nodes in the AI graph, and hover states. No purple/violet gradients allowed.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the dark sections to prevent digital flatness and give it a premium 'Vercel' feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders (`border-black/5` in light, `border-white/10` in dark) to ground elements. 'Tracing beam' glow effect on the AI Ad Intelligence Engine cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Avoid soft, muddy shadows. Use sharp, diffuse ambient shadows or stark 1px structural borders.

sections_and_layouts.name: Navigation Bar
sections_and_layouts.layout: Fixed top, glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFDFB]/80`), clean left-aligned logo, right-aligned nav links + Primary CTA.

sections_and_layouts.name: Hero Section
sections_and_layouts.layout: Editorial, aggressive asymmetry. Massive left-aligned H1 (`text-6xl md:text-8xl`), generous white space (`py-32`). A conceptual architectural image on the right offset to break the grid.

sections_and_layouts.name: Trust Bar (Social Proof)
sections_and_layouts.layout: Subtle horizontal marquee (`react-fast-marquee`) with logos of Trustpilot, G2, Reddit, WeChat. Styled monochromatic/grayscale.

sections_and_layouts.name: Pain Point (The $2 for $1 Problem)
sections_and_layouts.layout: Massive typography, data-driven. Big statistic: '+60% CAC in 5 years'. Simple layout, huge impact.

sections_and_layouts.name: AI Ad Intelligence / Trust Graph
sections_and_layouts.layout: Full width, immersive. This is the 'Tech Competence' moment. Use `react-tsparticles` for a striking animated node network connecting user avatars/data points in the background.

sections_and_layouts.name: How It Works (5-Step Flow)
sections_and_layouts.layout: Bento Grid (Mode A: Tetris Grid). 5 asymmetrical cards: Capture -> Personalize -> Amplify -> Enrich -> Convert. High density, 1px white/10 borders.

sections_and_layouts.name: Acquisition Loops Diagram
sections_and_layouts.layout: Visual section showing 'Organic Referrals' vs 'Smarter Paid Growth'. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for an overlapping, layered layout.

sections_and_layouts.name: Product Feature Grid
sections_and_layouts.layout: Return to light mode. 3-column grid (`md:grid-cols-3`). Generous padding (`gap-8`, `p-8` per card). Focus on readability.

sections_and_layouts.name: Outcomes & Metrics
sections_and_layouts.layout: Big numbers, minimal text. 3 massive metrics (e.g., '3x ROAS', '-40% CAC').

sections_and_layouts.name: FAQ
sections_and_layouts.layout: Standard accordion layout (`Shadcn Accordion`), but left-aligned within a max-w-3xl container.

sections_and_layouts.name: Final CTA & Lead Form
sections_and_layouts.layout: High-contrast form. Sends to deepthi@uplaud.ai. Crisp inputs, no generic rounded corners (use `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`).

sections_and_layouts.name: Footer
sections_and_layouts.layout: Massive bottom space (`py-24`). Huge 'Uplaud AI' text mark. Clean columns for links.

copywriting_examples.hero_h1: Turn Customer Trust into a Compounding Acquisition Engine.
copywriting_examples.hero_subhead: Stop paying the $2 for $1 tax on cold ads. Uplaud AI builds an intelligent Trust Graph from your reviews and referrals to lower CAC and multiply ROAS.
copywriting_examples.pain_point: Customer acquisition costs have risen 60% in 5 years. Cold traffic is dead. You're wasting spend on an algorithm that doesn't care about your brand.
copywriting_examples.solution_headline: The New Layer of Growth: Trust-Powered Acquisition.
copywriting_examples.ai_graph_subhead: We ingest reviews, social proof, and referrals to map high-intent lookalike clusters, feeding smarter data back into your ad loops.

media_and_3d.3d_instructions: Install `react-tsparticles` and `tsparticles` to create a 'network node' effect in the AI Trust Graph section. It should look like connecting dots/lines, colored in `#10B981` (Electric Emerald) with low opacity on a `#050505` background.

images.description: Minimalist geometric architecture. Use as an offset conceptual image in the light Hero section to convey structure, foundation, and editorial elegance.
3D wireframe polyhedron. Use as a background accent or card visual in the 'How It Works' bento grid.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure black text on the #FDFDFB light theme and pure white text on the #050505 dark theme. The #10B981 accent must be tested against dark backgrounds for 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.focus_states: All form inputs and buttons must have a `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#10B981] focus:ring-offset-2` outline.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="hero-book-demo-btn"`, `data-testid="lead-form-submit"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `react-tsparticles` and `tsparticles` for the AI Trust Graph node background.
Do NOT use `Inter` for headings. Embed `Clash Display` via Fontshare API and `Manrope` via Google Fonts in the index.html or main CSS.
Construct the page with a clear Light -> Dark -> Light -> Dark thematic transition as defined in sections_and_layouts.
The Hero section must NOT be center-aligned. Make it wildly asymmetrical. Huge left-aligned text, abstract architectural image bleeding off the right edge.
The AI Trust Graph section must feel like a completely different environment (dark mode, glowing green nodes via tsparticles, stark borders).

Forms must use Shadcn UI components but heavily customized to be sharp-edged (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`) to fit the brutalist tech vibe. Form action should direct submissions to deepthi@uplaud.ai (use a standard mailto or form handler block).
Never use generic placeholder images. Use the provided abstract images and Lucide icons.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to every single link, button, accordion trigger, and form input.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g., sticky header).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles. For this project, use sharp or slightly rounded crisp buttons, avoiding muddy soft shadows.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (`py-24` or `py-32`).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
